  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment is negative or low (e.g., < 0.33) to counteract overconfidence.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude by 5-10% if recent 7-day mean is rising sharply and sentiment is neutral or positive.",
    "Increase forecast lag by 1-2 days if sentiment is positive and price is trending upward, to avoid overshoot.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is > 10% above recent 30-day average, reduce by 10-15% unless sentiment strongly supports.",
    "If sentiment is positive and price spikes > 15% from prior day, cap forecast at 10% below peak to avoid overcorrection.",
    "For sentiment = 0.00, use 30-day moving average as baseline, then add 2-5% if recent volatility is high.",
    "If sentiment > 0.50 and forecast is below 30-day average, increase by 5-8% to align with bullish momentum."
  ]
}
